question: Will the 10-year minus 3-month U.S. Treasury par yield spread (Treasury daily par yield curve, percentage points) for 2025-05-15 (or the last business day before it with a published reading) be above 0.05 pp, its value for 2025-04-14?

rule.threshold_basis: the latest reading as of 2025-04-15 (2025-04-14), rounded as shown

source: Source: U.S. Treasury, Bureau of the Fiscal Service
